descriptionHtml:
Want the whole set? The PSX Character Library holds the CSAF PSX character packs on one page, plus every new one, for $19.99.

70 low poly PS1-style characters for Godot 4, Unity and Unreal: 14 modern soldiers, 14 Second World War soldiers, 14 city civilians, 14 wasteland raiders and 14 crime syndicate gangsters. Fort Vale, Foxhole, Crosstown, Ashfall and Syndicate share one page and one purchase, with free samplers of all five here. Every character is rigged to the same humanoid skeleton with the same 45 animation clips, about 1,500 triangles and one 256 px texture per skin, in GLB, FBX, OBJ and Blender formats. If you bought this page before, Foxhole is already in your itch library at no extra cost.

Foxhole: 14 Second World War soldiers of four armies (added November 2026)

  • Infantry of four armies, American, British, German and Soviet: US rifleman, German rifleman, British rifleman, Soviet rifleman, US sergeant, German machine gunner, Soviet sniper, British officer, US paratrooper, German squad leader, Soviet tank crewman, British commando, US medic and Soviet field medic. Every one an adult, each a different body and uniform.
  • Every helmet and cap is modelled, not painted: a round dome, a flat dish, a flared steel helmet, a high Soviet dome, a padded tank helmet, a peaked service cap, a field cap and a beret, so the armies read apart by silhouette.
  • Plain uniforms: no insignia, badges, patches, flags or emblems of any kind, and the medics carry plain bags with no red cross.
  • 3 skins each (42 to place): the uniform changes colour; faces, hair, boots and helmets keep their paint.
  • Honest limit: no rifles are painted or held, so the pistol clips aim an empty hand until you attach your own weapon.

Syndicate: 14 gangsters, hitmen and enforcers (added November 2026)

  • A 1990s city crime syndicate from the boss to the street: syndicate boss, club owner, hitman, getaway driver, enforcer, counsellor, loan shark, bodyguard, bookie, street runner, accountant, bouncer, safecracker and informant. Every one an adult, each a different body and outfit, in tailored suits, leather and street clothes.
  • The enemies a city shooter needs: the same skeleton and clip names as everyone on this page, so one animation setup drives them all.
  • 3 skins each (42 to place): the suit, jacket, blazer, sweater, waistcoat or cardigan changes colour; faces, hair, shirts and boots keep their paint.
  • Honest limit: there are no painted weapons, so the pistol clips aim an empty hand until you attach your own.

Ashfall: 14 post-apocalyptic raiders and wastelanders

  • The people of an ash-covered wasteland years after the collapse: raider boss, scavenger, gas mask trooper, wasteland medic, trader, dust prophet, mechanic, hunter, scarred brute, sniper, pit fighter, nomad, drifter and settlement elder, in dusty, patched, worn clothes, 3 skins each (42 to place).

Crosstown: 14 city civilians

  • The everyday street crowd of a modern city: commuter, bike courier, barista, construction worker, jogger, businesswoman, university student, grandmother, taxi driver, street vendor, tourist, bouncer, delivery rider and busker, 3 skins each (42 to place).
  • Honest limit: bags, a camera and a guitar case are painted on straps.

Fort Vale: 14 soldiers

  • The garrison of a fictional modern army base: rifleman, field officer, combat medic, special operator, helicopter pilot, combat engineer, radio operator, recruit, military police, veteran sergeant, quartermaster, grenadier, sniper and scout, in plain unmarked uniforms with 3 camouflage colourways each (42 to place).
  • Honest limit: the CC0 clip library has no rifle animations, so the rifles are painted slung across the backs and the soldiers fight with the pistol set.

Every character, all five packs

  • 45 animation clips plus a T-pose: idle, walk, formal walk, jog, sprint, crouch, jump, roll, punches, 6 pistol clips, sword, spell, two hit reactions, a death, sit, swim, push, pick up, interact, kneel and fix, talking, dance and driving.
  • PSX ready: textures quantised to 15-bit colour for nearest filtering, and a PSX shader for Godot 4 (vertex snapping, affine texture warp, 15-bit colour with dithering, distance fog).
  • Files: a GLB per skin, FBX with the skeleton and clips, OBJ, and the Blender source.
  • Honest limit: the hands are simple mittens and nothing is held in them.

Works with

Godot 4: copy models/ and shaders/ into the project and instance a _skin0.glb. All five packs were imported into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project: every GLB imports, the shader compiles and the clips play (Godot names Walk_Loop as Walk and loops it).

Unity 6 and Unreal 5: import the FBX and set the textures to point filtering; the skeleton retargets with Unity Humanoid or an Unreal IK Rig. These two engines were not run here; the FBX files were re-imported in Blender to check the mesh, 53 bones and every clip.

Try it free

Five free demo files on this page: the Fort Vale rifleman, the Foxhole British rifleman, the Crosstown construction worker, the Ashfall scavenger and the Syndicate boss, each with every skin, every clip, every format and the shader. Try more free first: the PSX Characters Sampler has one character from each of our PSX packs.

Licence and how it was made

Use the models in any number of commercial or free games, with no attribution and no royalty, and modify them freely. Do not resell or redistribute the models, textures or animations themselves as assets.

Every character here was made with AI tools. The bodies were built with MakeHuman (CC0 output) by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh (Crosstown, Ashfall, Syndicate and Foxhole: FLUX.2 klein). The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.

Versions

1.5: Foxhole added, 14 Second World War soldiers of four armies, November 2026. Earlier: Syndicate, Ashfall, Crosstown and the October rebuild; every change is in the devlogs.
